kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انعتلت (form VII)
# اِنْعَتَلْتُ (inʕataltu) /in.ʕa.tal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
# اِنْعَتَلْتَ (inʕatalta) /in.ʕa.tal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
# اِنْعَتَلْتِ (inʕatalti) /in.ʕa.tal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
# اِنْعَتَلَتْ (inʕatalat) /in.ʕa.ta.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
